chunks: So you persevere with patience (in your mission). The promise of God is true. Whether We show you some of the punishment We have promised them, or gather you up in death, they have to come back to Us.

key_terms.نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ: We cause you to die / gather you up

ai.seo_question: What are the two possibilities mentioned regarding the Prophet's experience of God's promise?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ghafir, this verse reassures the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) that divine justice is inevitable, whether manifested through the immediate punishment of the disbelievers or through the Prophet's own death. Shia scholarship emphasizes this duality as a source of comfort, highlighting that the Prophet's role is to convey the message while the ultimate outcome rests with God, reinforcing the concept of divine timing and the certainty of the Hereafter.
